title: ESSY Opening Identity
description: Canonical metadata for ESSY episode opening identity reveal. Represents the editorial decision of how/when the series title and episode title appear after the opening hook, over continuing footage. This is the preferred canonical path for ESSY-0004+ episodes. Backward compatible with legacy title-timing fields and coldOpenExperiment.

seriesTitle.description: Series title text for the identity reveal. Typically resolved from the shared ESSY_SERIES_IDENTITY but can be overridden per episode if editorially justified.

episodeTitle.description: Episode title text for the identity reveal. From WRITE-approved visual-only metadata (titles.json visualOnly entry with tts:false).

startSec.description: Absolute start time of the identity reveal on the main timeline (seconds). Derived from the end of the opening hook/narration block. t=0 is N001 start, not a pre-roll.

durationSec.description: Duration of the identity reveal (seconds). During this window, footage continues but narration and subtitles are suppressed (if enabled).

mode.description: How series title and episode title are presented. 'sequential' = series title appears first, then episode title. 'simultaneous' = both appear together. Defaults to 'sequential' if omitted.

seriesTitleFirst.description: When mode is 'sequential', whether series title appears before episode title. Defaults to true.

enabled.description: Whether narration is suppressed (muted) during the identity reveal window. Defaults to true for identity reveals.
Whether subtitles are suppressed during the identity reveal window. Defaults to true for identity reveals.
